component.name: GlassDesk
component.summary: Sort your desktop into glass fences, with widgets

description.p: GlassDesk sorts every file and shortcut on your desktop into frosted-glass fences, and adds widgets beside them. It blurs your own wallpaper, so the glass looks real on any desktop.

ul.li: Fences for apps, folders, documents, images, music and video, archives and other files, sorted as files change
Your own fences, folder fences and rules, like "*.pdf goes to School"
Stack fences or widgets with tabs, and fold 4 or more files of one type into a stack
14 widgets: clock, system monitor, calendar, notes, to-do, weather, photos, countdown, quote, GitHub stats, network, focus timer, music and Today
26 themes, including Mica and Acrylic, and an accent color that can match your wallpaper
A search window for your desktop and apps, with a calculator

screenshot.caption: Fences, a file stack and widgets on the desktop
Search for anything on your desktop and in your apps
Choose how your desktop gets organized

ul.li: Search lists every app, and you can drag apps onto fences
Smoother switching between stacked fences and widgets

description.p: 26 themes, stacks with tabs, music and Today widgets, a new search window and Organize desktop.
